raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of source content hierarchy and failure to distinguish between "Production Company" and "Distributor". In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the production company for both films was "Buena Vista Distribution Company" based on the fact that Buena Vista was listed as the distributor in the search results. The Planner failed to recognize that while Buena Vista (a Disney subsidiary) distributed the films, the actual production company was "Walt Disney Productions" (or Walt Disney Pictures), which was explicitly stated in the Wikipedia snippets visible in the viewport for both films. The Planner prematurely accepted the distributor information as the production company without verifying the specific "Production Company" field or cross-referencing the explicit text stating "made by Walt Disney Productions".
